{{Top|leg}}
The '''Under Minister of Information''' was a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Bureaucrat/Legends|bureaucratic]] position. Copies of all information gathered by the [[Bureau of Scouting and Exploration Services]] was turned over to the Under Minister, who was responsible for tracking ownership of [[Planet/Legends|planets]] and valuable data needed by the government or member worlds.
